sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: Lines between two positions, each in its tone over a casing in the card color: straight on the map or along the great circle, solid or dashed, and with measure a chip midway saying the distance and the bearing from where it starts, as the ruler's does. The link under the pointer thickens; the selected one is drawn in the selection color. Hundreds of links stay cheap.

anatomy.line: From one end to the other: along the great circle in steps of at most 50 km (64 at most), or straight on the map (the rhumb line); the width (1.5) in the tone, 0.75 more under the pointer and 1 more selected in map-selection, dashed 3 on 2 when dashed, round-capped, over a casing 2.5 wider in card at 80 percent.
anatomy.chip: Over the link's middle (along the great circle, or halfway along the straight line on the map), 8 above it: words.measured with the distance and the bearing, as the ruler's chip: text.xs at 500 in tabular figures on card, padded 6 across and 2 down, rounded by radius-control, with the surface's elevation and a 1 ring of foreground at 10 percent. A chip that would cover another, or a track's label (parts/track-layer) or a zone's label (parts/zone-layer) on the same map, is left out; the selected link's never is, and is placed first. Only chips whose middle is in view are written.

links.does: Each link { id, from, to, tone?, path?, dashed?, measure? }. Plain unless given. The tone is friend, hostile, neutral, unknown or pending, drawn in that track affiliation's token (track-friend and the rest), or plain, drawn in muted-foreground.

path.does: How each link runs unless the link says.

dashed.does: Dashes each link unless the link says.

measure.does: Shows each link's distance and bearing midway unless the link says.

unit.does: The unit a measure's distance is written in; whole meters under a kilometer.

colors.does: Colors for the tones in place of their tokens.

opacity.does: How opaque the whole layer is.

interactive.does: Links answer the pointer and presses; a press selects one as the map's selection.

chipLift.note: The chip's foot stands this far above the link's middle.

casing.note: How much wider the casing is than the line.

greatCircleStep.note: The longest step a great-circle link is drawn in, in meters; 64 steps at most.

hover.means: The pointer is over the link: it thickens.

selected.means: The map's selected link: drawn in the selection color, its chip placed first.
selected.reached: a press on it, or the map's selected

rest.note: In the link's tone token, over its casing.

sokkel-ui: Drawn on maplibre: every link one feature of one GeoJSON source, with a casing and a solid and a dashed line layer, however many links there are.
A straight link's measure is along the rhumb line (rhumbDistance, rhumbBearing), its middle halfway up the Mercator scale (rhumbMiddle); a great-circle link's as the ruler's.
Chips are written in the map's overlay, projected again after every move, only those in view.

drift.today: As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
